title: Marketing & AI Intern
description: Marketing & AI Intern Thermeleon | Internship | The Netherlands About Thermeleon Thermeleon is a technology-driven company working at the intersection of energy, technology and sustainable horticulture. We develop innovative solutions that contribute to a more sustainable greenhouse industry while helping reduce pressure on the electricity grid. We are a growing team with big ambitions, and we're looking for someone who wants to help shape how Thermeleon presents itself to the world. The role We're looking for a creative, proactive and tech-savvy Marketing Intern who wants to take ownership and build things from the ground up. You'll work on refreshing our brand, developing marketing materials and building our digital marketing infrastructure using modern AI tools such as Claude Code. You'll have the opportunity to combine creativity, marketing strategy and technology, while seeing your work directly impact a growing company. What you'll be working on 1. Brand Refresh Help refine and strengthen the Thermeleon brand identity. Develop a consistent visual and communication style. Translate our brand positioning into a compelling brand experience. 2. Marketing Materials Update and develop our marketing materials, including presentations, brochures, one-pagers and other sales collateral. Create visual content for internal and external communication. Ensure consistency across all marketing touchpoints. 3. Build the Thermeleon Website with Claude Code Take part in rebuilding and developing the Thermeleon website using Claude Code. Translate ideas and designs into functional web pages. Improve website structure, user experience and content. Explore how AI can accelerate website development. 4. Build a Content Marketing Machine with Claude Code Help build a scalable content marketing system using AI. Develop workflows for content creation, planning and distribution. Create a content calendar and establish a consistent publishing rhythm. Explore AI-powered tools and automations to make marketing more efficient. Who we're looking for You're studying Marketing, Communication, Creative Business, Digital Media, or a related field. You're creative, curious and entrepreneurial. You have an interest in AI, technology and digital tools. You're excited about experimenting with tools like Claude Code (coding experience is a plus, but not a requirement). You have an eye for design, branding and visual communication. You take initiative and enjoy turning ideas into reality. You're comfortable working independently and taking ownership of projects. You have excellent communication skills in English. Speaking Dutch is a plus What we offer A hands-on internship where you'll have real ownership and responsibility. The opportunity to build the marketing foundation of a growing technology company. Freedom to experiment with AI and emerging technologies. A close-knit, ambitious and international team. Plenty of room to learn, experiment and bring your own ideas to life. An internship compensation of €400 per month. Interested? We'd love to hear from you! Send us your CV and a short introduction explaining why this internship interests you. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
